research_scope: Dimensional Hole — Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research commit for Dimensional Hole was found. The canonical identity is Super / Ki Blast; counter behavior remains a taxonomy property.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Dimensional Hole as a Ki Blast Super and Ki Blast Counter. It creates a barrier that absorbs a basic Ki Blast and launches a projectile from behind the opponent.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Dimensional Hole is obtainable from Parallel Quest 80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest.
verification_audit.finish_finding: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Dimensional Hole under PQ80 Basic Reward, so an Ultimate Finish is not required for this reward.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The skill reference lists 0 Ki cost. No reliable reviewed source established a stamina cost or drop probability, so those remain null.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies the Future Warrior as an obtainable user, supporting CaC availability.

records.name: Dimensional Hole
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Dimensional Hole under PQ80 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Create a dimensional hole that swallows normal Ki Blast moves; if it connects, an explosion erupts behind the opponent and blows them forward.
records.mechanics_notes: The skill creates a clear barrier in front of the user. When a Basic Ki Blast hits the barrier, a projectile is launched behind the opponent and deals approximately 15% damage. The reviewed Xenoverse 2 reference describes it as a Ki Blast counter rather than a universal counter.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ80 is the documented Future Warrior route. Community reports confirm the skill can be a difficult random drop, but no probability is asserted.
records.pve_notes: The skill is a documented PQ80 reward and is useful against Basic Ki Blast pressure; no unsupported reward probability is recorded.
records.pvp_notes: The documented counter behavior targets Basic Ki Blasts. Later/community descriptions may discuss broader behavior, but this record preserves the narrower authoritative skill-reference description.
